calc.batteryDataNote: PROVISIONAL battery spec (2026-10-09). avgPowerDrawKw and chargerPowerKw were BLANK on the owner sheet, so they are BACK-DERIVED from this platform's existing [estimate] runtime and charge time: draw = usable kWh / runTimeHr, charger = usable kWh / chargeHr. They therefore inherit that estimate's uncertainty and are NOT measurements -- `batterySpecProvisional` is set so every surface can say so. Replacing them with the real figures is the whole fix: six cells across the three platforms completes the library. Chemistry is AGM, the most charge-sensitive in the library, so the provisional charge input is the least trustworthy of the three.
